raw_segments.text: Bomb, upset. A coffin bumped out onto the road, burst open.
Patty Dignum shot out and rolling over stiff in the dust in a brown habit too large for
Mouth fallen open, asking what's up now, quite right to close it. Looks horrid open.
Then the insides decompose quickly. Much better to close up all the orifices. Yes, also, with
wax. The sphincter loose. Seal up all.
